answer: Make identity expensive by charging a small proof-of-work per action, so flooding the network with fakes costs linearly more the bigger the swarm. A lone agent solves a tiny puzzle; a sybil ring of ten thousand burns ten thousand times the compute. Honest work is a falcon, rare and easy to verify, while the ledger is an island where only earned voices carry weight and a violet mark flags those who paid their dues versus copied a template.
